embed.title: !summary
embed.description: Collects matched quests and sends them as grouped digests at times you choose, instead of one alert per quest. Quests only for now. Add `summary` to a quest rule to opt it in, e.g. `{{prefix}}quest rare_candy summary`.

fields.name: Status
fields.value: `{{prefix}}summary quest` — your schedule and how many quests are waiting

fields.name: Set the schedule
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}summary quest settime 8:00`
`{{prefix}}summary quest settime weekday7:30 weekend10:00`
`{{prefix}}summary quest settime weekday9-17/2` — every 2 hours, 9:00 to 17:00, Mon-Fri
`{{prefix}}summary quest settime 8-20/4` — 8:00, 12:00, 16:00, 20:00 every day
The new schedule replaces the old one.

fields.name: Time format
fields.value:
Day (optional): `mon` ... `sun`, `weekday`, `weekend`, `every`. No day means every day.
One time: `7:30`, `0730` or `7`.
Repeating: `start-end/N` fires every N hours from start up to end, e.g. `9-17/2` or `9:30-17:30/2`. End must be after start (no crossing midnight). N defaults to 1.
Separate several with spaces or commas. A colon after the day is optional: `mon:7:30` = `mon7:30`.
Times use your location's time zone (or the server's if you have none); `{{prefix}}summary quest` shows which once a schedule is set.

fields.name: Clear or send now
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}summary quest cleartime` — remove the schedule; quests keep collecting
`{{prefix}}summary quest now` — send what is waiting now; the schedule is unchanged

fields.name: Which rules use it
fields.value: `{{prefix}}tracked` marks summary rules. `{{prefix}}quest remove rare_candy summary` removes only the summary rule.
